In this run it was 'business_impact' (progress stuck at 6 of 7 validated), preventing Send. Backend logic itself is proven correct via API — the failure is in the compose UI state.

ui_bugs.component: app/compose/[id].tsx – Validate & Lock for a section containing the countries dropdown
ui_bugs.issue: Validate & Lock deterministically fails to lock one section per compose run — in iteration 1 it was 'timing', in this run it is 'business_impact' (the section that now contains the Countries multi-select). Progress stays at 6 of 7 validated so the 'Send via Email' button never enables and the user cannot reach Preview. Suspected cause is still the same: validateSection's `missing` check closes over `values` from render scope, while the sections list identity churns (LinearTransition + ['draft', id] invalidation on every updateDraft.onSuccess), so the click's handler references a stale values snapshot where the just-set countries JSON is missing. Fix: read from stateRef.current.values inside validateSection's missing check, or suppress ['draft', id] invalidation while the compose screen is mounted (staleTime Infinity), or don't re-hydrate after saves. Note: the code already uses functional setValidations, so the previous fix was partial — the `missing` check is the remaining stale-closure.

integration_issues.issue: Same as iteration 1: full flow to Preview is blocked because one section per run refuses to lock. Backend render endpoint is fully working (verified via pytest) but users can't reach it from the mobile UI without unlocking/relocking the affected section.

action_items: In /app/frontend/app/compose/[id].tsx, change validateSection's `missing` check from `values[f.key]` to `stateRef.current.values[f.key]` so it reads the latest values (fixes stale closure when countries were just selected). Additionally, remove `queryClient.invalidateQueries(['draft', id])` from useUpdateDraft.onSuccess (or set staleTime infinite for the ['draft', id] key while mounted) so the draft doesn't refetch after every save and cause section identity churn under LinearTransition.

After the fix, re-run: templates → tap first IMCR card → open Countries → tick Italy + Austria → Done → Validate & Lock each of the 7 sections → confirm all 7 lock, Send enables, Preview shows chip list containing dtps.siam@cchellenic.com, DTPS.Country.Platform.Directors@cchellenic.com, Italy + Austria platform_directors + country_dl + country_dtps + dwt_leader emails, plus product_team & sre after they are typed, and body contains readable 'Italy, Austria'.

rca_of_issue: Same root cause as iteration 1 but different manifestation section. The `validateSection` handler in compose/[id].tsx reads `values[f.key]` from render closure. When a section contains a bottom-sheet input (Countries), the click sequence is: openSheet → setValue(countries, JSON) → close sheet → tap Validate & Lock. Between setValue and the next render committing, the handler bound to the Animated.View card can retain a stale `values` snapshot where the countries JSON is still empty, causing `missing` to be truthy → toast 'Fill in all fields before validating' fires and setValidations is skipped. Fix: read via `stateRef.current.values` in the missing check, since stateRef is updated on every render (line 68-69 already keeps it fresh). Also removing the ['draft', id] invalidation from useUpdateDraft.onSuccess eliminates unnecessary refetches that churn section identity under LinearTransition.
